faq.a1: Nothing. SofIA is free and supported by ads, always clearly labeled. You decide whether they're tailored to your interests in {path:settingsTitle,settingsOptionPrivacy,settingsPrivacyAds}. What you write, your interests and your wellbeing data never travel in an ad.
faq.a2: Whoever you choose, entry by entry: just you, your circle, your followers or everyone. You can post unsigned, schedule an entry for later and make your whole journal private.
faq.a3: It transcribes your audio, summarizes and organizes your entries and helps you spot the patterns. It runs on SofIA's servers and, in part, on your own phone. Your journal is never used to train models. The AI Policy covers it in detail.
faq.a4: Right now the app is in Spanish, and you can write in whatever language you like. We're getting more languages ready.
faq.a5: Yes, both, whenever you want. We walk you through it in Help and Delete your account.
faq.a6: Your journal travels encrypted between your phone and our servers, and only the people you choose can read it. To transcribe it, summarize it, review what gets shared and show it to whoever you pick, our servers need to read it, so it isn't end-to-end encryption. On your phone, you can lock your journal with your fingerprint or your face.
